{床|ゆか}が{濡|ぬ}れている{場合|ばあい}は、{床|ゆか}の{水|みず}をきちんとふき{取|と}る

terms.term: {未熟練作業者|みじゅくれんさぎょうしゃ}

terms.def_en: An accident caused by slipping while running, tripping over something, or not walking straight while carrying a load. You may hit your head or back, or break a bone in your hand. It is the most common accident in food factories.

terms.term: はさまれ・{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれ{災害|さいがい}

terms.def_en: An accident that happens when you put your hand into a machine or clean a conveyor gear. It can crush fingers or arms, or trap and kill a person.

terms.def: {気温|きおん}や{湿度|しつど}が{高|たか}い{場所|ばしょ}で{長|なが}い{時間|じかん}{作業|さぎょう}したときに{起|お}こる。{体温|たいおん}が{上|あ}がって{体内|たいない}の{水分|すいぶん}や{塩分|えんぶん}のバランスが{崩|くず}れ、{体温調節|たいおんちょうせつ}ができなくなり、{死|し}ぬこともある。

terms.def_en: An accident where a moving worker is hit by a forklift or similar. Being hit by a fast-moving forklift can be fatal.

terms.term: 5S

terms.def_en: Sort, set in order, clean, cleanliness, and discipline. It keeps the workplace always in the same condition and is an important activity for preventing accidents.

terms.term: {動線|どうせん}

terms.def_en: Helmets, goggles, gloves, earplugs, heat-resistant aprons, safety shoes, etc., worn to prevent injury. When you are told to wear them, you must wear them correctly.

terms.term: {高所作業|こうしょさぎょう}

terms.term: {始業前点検|しぎょうまえてんけん}
